svg.title: Deadlock, Race Condition, and Starvation in Java
svg.desc: Three diagrams showing the difference between deadlock (two threads blocking each other), race condition (two threads writing at the same time), and starvation (one thread never getting access).
svg.text: Each thread holds one lock and waits for the other — forever
Two threads read and write the same variable at the same time
Low-priority thread never gets CPU time because high-priority threads keep running
